purpose: Defines the fields, preconditions, and structure of the 'Specimen Collection Order' screen within workflow WF_005.
preconditions: An active lab order exists for the patient
postconditions: All required fields on 'Specimen Collection Order' are captured and saved before advancing to the next screen.
validations: Confirm specimen type matches the requirements of the ordered test
Confirm collection priority (routine vs. STAT) is reflected before the specimen is collected
common_errors: Specimen type selected does not match the requirements of the ordered test
